title: Kagamine Rin — Sending My Singing Voice〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: On This Blank Canvas, I Paint

rows.Line: Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
No one's here. I'm so bored...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Kanade and the others are probably busy working on their song.)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (I don't actually know how much of it's done, but I wish they'd let me listen to it...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I guess I could go find Miku and play some cat's cradle with her...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh? Ena...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
(When did she get here...?
I probably didn't notice because I was wandering around...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Ena...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Is that you, Rin...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, it's me.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Can you not surprise me like that?
Ugh... This line's in the wrong spot now...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Is that a sketchbook...?
Are you drawing something?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, I decided to go traditional for a change.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
(But her drawing...
It looks like a mess.)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (I can sort of tell what it is...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (And yet, I have no idea what she's trying to convey.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's a total mess, right...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But I feel like I need to draw something... Anything... So I kept drawing and erasing this thing over and over again...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Ena...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I have to keep drawing...
I'm making Kanade and the others wait on me...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'm not sure what's going on with you, but did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Sorry. I haven't told you yet, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You don't have to tell me if you don't want to...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No, I kinda want you to hear.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm going to this art class for a few days to actually learn more about art...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But everyone there is so much better than me, and I haven't been able to draw what comes to mind at all...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Is that why you're so frustrated...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, pretty much...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (This doesn't seem like the full story...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
(But I've never seen her so down...
I should probably leave her alone...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Why don't you just take a break from drawing since it's bothering you so much...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I have nothing else to do, so we can play cat's cradle or something.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I mean...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Thanks, Rin...
But...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I have to keep drawing...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I understand.
I hope you draw something good...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Me too...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Rin...?
What's the matter? You seem concerned.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I just went over to see Ena...
She seemed sad...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I thought about asking her more about how she's feeling, but decided against it... I didn't want to be too much of a bother...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Would you like to play cat's cradle with me?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Why?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Because you seem sad too.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
...
Okay...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Still...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (What's going on with Ena...?)
